header: Cliffwater wrote the book on private debt. With decades of experience and deep institutional knowledge, they are trusted advisers in a complex space. But their story only made sense to people who already knew the space.

summary.shipped: A two-minute explainer video on private debt

media.name: 1.mp4
media.title: Private debt: staying dry in stormy markets

text: Cliffwater faced a difficult challenge. How do you explain private debt to a broader audience in a way that feels easy to grasp, without losing the nuance that institutional investors expect?

media.name: 2.mp4
media.title: Solving the puzzle behind the returns

text: I art directed, edited, and animated this two minute video that became the centerpiece of that effort. I also helped with the script to make sure it was as focused as possible. The video translates the moving parts of private debt into simple metaphors, guiding viewers from first principles to a clear understanding of private debt and Cliffwater’s role within it.

media.name: 3.mp4
media.title: Steady through rising and falling interest rates

text: Instead of leaning on jargon, I built the narrative around plain language, thoughtful pacing, and a clean visual system. Abstract concepts are grounded in relatable motion, typography, and framing, so the information lands without feeling simplified or watered down.

What began as an educational piece became something larger. The video now acts as a living expression of the brand a clear, confident system of language and visuals that makes private debt approachable while reinforcing Cliffwater’s depth of expertise.
